module_summary: Direct-mapped write-through cache controller: 5-state FSM latches CPU request, compares tag/valid arrays, fills misses and forwards writes over a req/ack memory bus.

anchors.name: cur
anchors.why: Controller state: idle, probe, write-through, miss fill, respond; decodes all handshakes.

anchors.name: words
anchors.why: Data array of LINES words; filled from memory or updated on write hit.

anchors.name: keys
anchors.why: Tag array written on fill, compared against request tag.

anchors.name: vld
anchors.why: Per-line valid bits set on fill, qualify hit.

anchors.name: match
anchors.why: Hit flag: valid and tag equal; steers probe transition and write update.

anchors.name: sel
anchors.why: Line index from latched address selecting tag, data, valid entries.

anchors.name: lat_a
anchors.why: Latched request address held across the operation; drives index, tag, mem_addr.

anchors.name: lat_d
anchors.why: Latched write data for write-through and cache update.

anchors.name: lat_w
anchors.why: Latched write command choosing write-through path in probe.

anchors.name: cpu_req_valid
anchors.why: CPU request; accepted in idle, latches address/data.

anchors.name: cpu_req_ready
anchors.why: Ready while FSM idle.

anchors.name: cpu_we
anchors.why: Read/write command latched with request.

anchors.name: cpu_addr
anchors.why: Request address latched into holding register.

anchors.name: cpu_wdata
anchors.why: CPU write data latched for write-through.

anchors.name: cpu_resp_valid
anchors.why: One-cycle response pulse in ACK state with read data.

anchors.name: cpu_rdata
anchors.why: Response data from output buffer: hit word, fill data or write data.

anchors.name: stall_o
anchors.why: Level stall while FSM is probing or waiting on memory.

anchors.name: mem_req
anchors.why: Memory request in fill or write-through states.

anchors.name: mem_we
anchors.why: Memory write enable asserted in write-through state.

anchors.name: mem_addr
anchors.why: Memory address driven from latched request address.

anchors.name: mem_wdata
anchors.why: Memory write data from latched write data.

anchors.name: mem_ack
anchors.why: Memory acknowledge completing fill or write-through.

anchors.name: mem_rdata
anchors.why: Refill data written into data array and output buffer.

anchors.name: fill_go
anchors.why: Refill enable writing tag, data, valid on memory ack in fill state.

anchors.name: wr_go
anchors.why: Write-hit update enable for data array on write-through ack.

groups.name: cache_fsm
groups.description: State machine sequencing probe, miss fill, write-through and response.

groups.name: tag_data_arrays
groups.description: Tag, valid and data arrays with index and hit compare.

groups.name: request_latch
groups.description: Latched address, write data, write flag and response buffer.

groups.name: cpu_port
groups.description: CPU request/response handshake with address and data.

groups.name: mem_port
groups.description: Memory bus request/ack for refill reads and write-through.
